metadata.title: AI-related measures and self-reported lesson-aim attainment: an explainable machine-learning analysis of TALIS 2024

design_fields.q1_rationale: Plausible values are not applicable because the dependent variable is constructed from TALIS self-report items rather than using PV-based cognitive achievement scales.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study explicitly states that it did not use sampling weights in the analysis.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study does not mention using multilevel modeling or any methods that account for school clustering in the analysis.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions internal validation methods such as paired bootstrap intervals and country-by-school grouped validation, indicating that it did not validate findings on an external dataset.
